from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
base=Path('/var/www/node/php-companion/.vscode-test');roots=[Path('/var/www/node/php-companion'),Path('/var/www/node/twig-plus')]
name=sys.argv[1];cwd=sys.argv[2];command=sys.argv[3:];assert name.replace('-','').isalnum() and command
manifest=base/f'{name}-input.json';record_path=base/f'{name}-run.json';log=base/f'{name}.log'
assert not any(p.exists() for p in [manifest,record_path,log])
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
inputs={};states={}
for root in roots:
 states[str(root)]={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'status':subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=root,text=True)}
 paths=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines())
 for directory in [*list((root/'packages').glob('*/dist')),root/'dist']:
  paths.update(str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
 for p in sorted(paths):
  path=root/p
  if path.is_file():inputs[str(path)]=sha(path)
for filename in ['d274-entry-store.mjs', 'd274-index.mjs', 'd274-benchmark-entry-store.mjs', 'd274-entry-store-controls.mjs']:
 path=base/filename;inputs[str(path)]=sha(path)
inputs[str(base/'d276-entry-store-edge-controls.mjs')]=sha(base/'d276-entry-store-edge-controls.mjs')
inputs[str(base/'d277-deferred-getter-count.mjs')]=sha(base/'d277-deferred-getter-count.mjs')
inputs[str(Path(__file__))]=sha(__file__)
snapshot={'command':command,'cwd':cwd,'inputs':inputs,'inputCount':len(inputs),'repositories':states,'nodeVersion':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version'],text=True).strip(),'twigBundleSha256':sha(roots[1]/'packages/vscode/dist/server.js'),'coreBundleSha256':sha(roots[0]/'dist/language-server.js')}
manifest.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot,indent=2)+'\n');started=time.monotonic()
with log.open('x') as output:
 child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 record={'status':'running','parentPid':__import__('os').getpid(),'childPid':child.pid,'startedAtUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'command':command,'manifest':str(manifest)}
 record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True);code=child.wait()
record.update(status='exited',exitCode=code,durationSeconds=time.monotonic()-started,finishedAtUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),changedInputs=[p for p,h in inputs.items() if not Path(p).is_file() or sha(p)!=h],repositoryChanges=[str(root) for root in roots if subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()!=states[str(root)]['head'] or subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=root,text=True)!=states[str(root)]['status']],logSha256=sha(log))
record_path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
assert not record['changedInputs'] and not record['repositoryChanges']
raise SystemExit(code)
